products.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Data Governance & DLP Guardrails — Commercial
products.short_description: Govern what Copilot can touch — sensitivity labels, DLP for Copilot, and data-loss guardrails around AI prompts and responses.
products.description:
Govern what Copilot can touch — sensitivity labels, DLP for Copilot, and data-loss guardrails around AI prompts and responses.

Once Copilot is live, the question becomes what it's allowed to use and produce. This solution applies sensitivity labels and DLP policies scoped to Copilot, restricts labeled content from AI processing where required, and adds guardrails around prompts and generated content — piloted in simulation before enforcement.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Sensitivity-label strategy applied to Copilot-accessible content
  • DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot — restrict labeled/sensitive data in AI
  • Guardrails on prompt and response handling
  • Audit and eDiscovery of Copilot interactions
  • Simulation-first rollout before enforcing block actions

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Copilot with governed boundaries — sensitive data stays out of AI unless it's allowed, provably and auditably.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CPLTGOV-AuditSearch.ps1 — Retrieve Microsoft 365 Copilot interaction audit events (READ-ONLY)
    • CPLTGOV-Discovery.ps1 — Discover sensitivity-label coverage and sensitive content for Copilot governance (READ-ONLY)
    • CPLTGOV-Guardrails.ps1 — Create Copilot governance controls SIMULATION/TEST-first (auto-labeling, DLP-for-Copilot)
    • CPLTGOV-Report.ps1 — Compile the Copilot data-governance evidence record (READ-ONLY)
    • CPLTGOV-Validate.ps1 — Confirm the Copilot governance controls are in the expected PILOT state (READ-ONLY)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
